Class AnnotationMetadata

java.lang.Object
be.imgn.inject.context.AnnotationMetadata
public final class AnnotationMetadata extends Object
The framework-related annotations captured at an injection point or provision definition: every annotation whose type carries InjectingAnnotation, QualifyingAnnotation, or ScopingAnnotation.

Annotations are held as AnnotationValue data computed at compile time, so inspection needs no reflection: 

metadata.get(Named.class).flatMap(AnnotationValue::stringValue);      // by type
metadata.byStereotype(QualifyingAnnotation.class);                    // every qualifier at this site

At most one annotation per annotation type is held, matching the language rule for non-repeatable annotations.
